source.sqlReaderQuery:
Select row_number() OVER (ORDER BY bk_service ASC) AS sk_service, *
From STG_Telco_Silver_Layer.dbo.stg_dim_service

Select row_number() OVER (ORDER BY bk_location ASC) AS sk_location, *
From STG_Telco_Silver_Layer.dbo.stg_dim_location

SELECT 
    /* 1. GENERATE THE NEW SURROGATE KEY */
    ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY stg_dim_customer.bk_customer ASC) AS sk_customer,

    /* 2. Retrieve the NEW snowflake foreign keys from the final DW tables */
    dim_service.sk_service AS NEW_fk_service,
    dim_location.sk_location AS NEW_fk_location,
    
    /* 3. Pull actual attributes required to be loaded into the DW */
    stg_dim_customer.bk_customer,
    stg_dim_customer.Gender,
    stg_dim_customer.Age,
    stg_dim_customer.Married,
    stg_dim_customer.Under30,
    stg_dim_customer.SeniorCitizen,
    stg_dim_customer.Dependents,
    stg_dim_customer.NumberofDependents,
    stg_dim_customer.CLTV,
    stg_dim_customer.Offer,
    stg_dim_customer.PaymentMethod,
    stg_dim_customer.PaperlessBilling,
    stg_dim_customer.Contract,
    stg_dim_customer.ReferredaFriend,
    stg_dim_customer.NumberofReferrals,
    stg_dim_customer.PhoneService,
    stg_dim_customer.MultipleLines,
    stg_dim_customer.OnlineSecurity,
    stg_dim_customer.OnlineBackup,
    stg_dim_customer.DeviceProtectionPlan,
    stg_dim_customer.PremiumTechSupport,
    stg_dim_customer.StreamingTV,
    stg_dim_customer.StreamingMovies,
    stg_dim_customer.StreamingMusic,
    stg_dim_customer.UnlimitedData,
    stg_dim_customer.fk_service,
    stg_dim_customer.fk_location

FROM STG_Telco_Silver_Layer.dbo.stg_dim_customer
/* Changed to LEFT JOIN so empty dimension tables don't wipe out your staging data */
LEFT JOIN DW_Telco_Data_Warehouse.dbo.dim_service
    ON stg_dim_customer.fk_service = dim_service.bk_service
LEFT JOIN DW_Telco_Data_Warehouse.dbo.dim_location
    ON stg_dim_customer.fk_location = dim_location.bk_location;

Select row_number() OVER (ORDER BY bk_date ASC) AS sk_date, *
From STG_Telco_Silver_Layer.dbo.stg_dim_date

SELECT 
    /* "old" foreign keys from Staging Area (values of the business keys) */
    stg_fact_customer_transactions.fk_date,
    stg_fact_customer_transactions.fk_customer,
    
    /* the NEW foreign keys, retrieved from the values of the SK in the DW */
    dim_date.sk_date as NEW_fk_date,
    dim_customer.sk_customer as NEW_fk_customer,
    
    /* actual measures, required to be loaded into the DW */
    stg_fact_customer_transactions.MonthlyCharge,
    stg_fact_customer_transactions.TenureMonths,
    stg_fact_customer_transactions.Status,
    stg_fact_customer_transactions.ChurnCategory,
    stg_fact_customer_transactions.ChurnReason

FROM STG_Telco_Silver_Layer.dbo.stg_fact_customer_transactions
LEFT JOIN DW_Telco_Data_Warehouse.dbo.dim_date ON stg_fact_customer_transactions.fk_date = dim_date.bk_date
LEFT JOIN DW_Telco_Data_Warehouse.dbo.dim_customer ON stg_fact_customer_transactions.fk_customer = dim_customer.bk_customer
